prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic full-body fashion-performance photograph of one clearly adult woman with long dark softly waved hair during an industrial motion-capture rehearsal among suspended fabric panels. She holds a controlled diagonal rehearsal stride with one arm reaching across a hanging panel gap. She wears an athletic unitard: the fitted upper garment and waist remain one continuous unit; the same garment continues from the waist through a visible crotch; a visible inseam separates two fitted unitard legs; both unitard legs keep one coherent selected short or long length, here short with matching mid-thigh hems; a bodysuit with separate shorts, matching separates, a dress, or loose romper cannot substitute. Limited three-quarter head-to-toe framing includes both feet. The upper garment, waist, crotch/rise, both fitted legs, leg openings/hems, and full silhouette must all remain clearly inspectable in one frame. Panels stay behind; waist, rise, inseam, legs, and hems stay unobstructed. Raised mocap dots sit above fabric, distinct from seams. Cool and warm practical light reveals continuity. The supplied portrait guides adult face, hair, and general appearance only for this fictional scene. Avoid: 3D render look, distorted fingers, body distortion, plastic-looking skin, low resolution, illustration look, cartoon style, over-processed retouching, excessive HDR
